title: Family on Farm with Work Horse, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century candid photograph taken on June 14, 1949, capturing a family scene on a farm. Identified on the back as Aunt Julia, Dad, and Connie, two women stand near a horse while a man handles the reins in an open agricultural field. A notable diagonal light leak or camera exposure artifact stretches across the upper half of the image.
